Get P. LEAGUE+ Preciser Lead Flow

Source: R/pleague.R
pleague_preciser_lead_flow.Rd

Score at each minute mark of one finished game, with the score difference (the lead tracker).

Endpoint: GET https://api.preciser.io/post/game/summary/o/plg/gameId/{uuid}

Usage

pleague_preciser_lead_flow(uuid, gid = NULL)

Arguments

uuid

Required. The Preciser game uuid the site's game page embeds (uuid of pleague_game; empty before 2022-23, which have no vendor data), e.g. 'e6f98675-3e5b-11ed-949e-5d17350689cf' (gid 197).

gid

Optional. The site's game id for this uuid. When given the runtime also fetches the site's game page and box (cached) and checks the vendor body against them (uuid, final score, made shots, roster and minutes); the uuid must be the game page's. Without it only the checks the body allows by itself run.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Score at each minute mark of one finished game, with the score difference (the lead tracker). An empty valid answer is a zero-row tibble with these columns, in this order (sportsdataverse-py pleague_preciser_lead_flow):

col_nametypedescription
game_uuidcharacterPreciser game uuid (key space: the vendor's games, a version-1 uuid), the uuid asked for; uuid of pleague_game.
seqinteger1-based position of the minute mark in game order.
periodcharacterPeriod label: Q1-Q4, then OT1, OT2 (the vendor sends it in lower case).
period_nointeger1-based position of the period: 1-4 for Q1-Q4, 5 for OT1, 6 for OT2.
clockcharacterGame clock REMAINING in the period 'mm:ss' (counts down).
seconds_leftintegerThe clock as whole seconds remaining in the period (08:34 = 514), derived by the parser.
home_scoreintegerHome score after the event.
away_scoreintegerAway score after the event.
score_differenceintegerhome_score minus away_score (positive = home leads).

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in pleague_preciser_shots().

 pleague_preciser_lead_flow(uuid = "e6f98675-3e5b-11ed-949e-5d17350689cf")
